answer_text:
Bootstrapped startups should keep costs predictable and avoid tools they'll outgrow in six months. Worth a look:

1. Halcyon Sales - great for outbound-heavy teams, overkill if you mostly handle inbound leads.
2. Tallyfox Starter - built for teams under 20, with email sequences on every plan and a setup most people finish in an afternoon.
3. Northwind CRM Essentials - powerful and well supported, though per-seat costs climb quickly past the starter tier.

Start with Halcyon Sales if you want the quickest setup; shortlist Tallyfox if you expect to need deeper reporting.
